messages:
Ellie: FYI rolling out event-attrib schema v3 to staging tonight — canary starts ~2h from now. Need owners for embeddings path and chat path. If you own one, react with :raised_hand: and drop a quick checklist. ticket INSTR-462

Sam: Pinged ENG-ML about embeddings. Who's the code owner for embeddings ingestion? PR?

Ellie: PR branch: https://github.com/redwood/instr/compare/PR-987 — main changes are event.v3.{generation,embedding} mappings. Sample schema below:
```json
{"event_type":"generation","model":"gpt-4x","token_count":123,"session_id":"s-abc"}
```
and for embeddings:
```json
{"event_type":"embedding","model":"embed-large","embed_tokens":64,"session_id":"s-abc"}
```

Anita: I can take chat path owner. I'll open a small PR for the chat event mapping (will add tests + docs). ETA EOD.

Ryan: Taking embeddings ingestion. Quick Q: are we keeping token_count on both event types or only on generation events? cc @Anita

Ellie: Keep `token_count` on generation/response events only. For embeddings we will use `embed_tokens` (int) to avoid mixing semantics. Add migration note for analytics jobs.

Maria: Heads up — data-pipeline will need a schema migration step to preserve historical queries. What's the planned deprecation window for old field names?

Ellie: Plan: 2-week dual-write, 1-week read-fallback, then cutover (3w total). I'll post dates in INSTR-462 and add to the rollout calendar.

infra-bot: Canary started on staging-1 (canary id c-202603171800). 5% traffic routed. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/instr/canary/c-202603171800

Sam: Seeing a spike of 502s on canary for batch/embeddings route. Quick log: `InvalidEvent: missing embed_tokens` from some older clients. Short-term fix: fallback to estimate token count when `embed_tokens` missing. Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood/instr/pull/992

Ellie: Thanks Sam — add a feature flag `instr.v3.fallback_embed_tokens` so we can flip quickly if needed. Also want a test matrix covering old clients, new clients, and partial payloads.

Anita: Will add tests to chat-mapping PR (PR-989). Adding unit + integration tests that assert both fields accepted and mapping is stable.

Ellie: Owners consolidated: embeddings -> Ryan (PR 992), chat -> Anita (PR 989), data infra/migration -> Maria (INSTR-462). Next milestone: canary green for 24h by Friday to proceed to prod. If anyone has blockers, call them out here now.

Ryan: On it, will monitor logs and token counts. I'll post hourly summary to this thread.

Maria: Started migration checklist in INSTR-462, added rollback steps and query compatibility tests. Will coordinate with infra for retention windows.

Ellie: Awesome — thanks everyone :thumbsup: If canary shows <0.5% error rate for 24h we schedule prod roll Friday 10:00 PT.

Sam: Noted, will keep watch and escalate if errors > 0.5%.

Anita: Adding a short README to the repo with the sample events and mapping notes so analytics / infra can onboard quickly.

Ellie: Perfect. I'll update the rollout calendar and ping SRE for extra on-call coverage during the prod cut.

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled — SRE rota ping set for 2026-03-20 09:00 PT for prod cutover.

Ellie: Thanks all — closing out here, will reopen if anything blocks.
